drives: RVND oversight holds, lane revocation/supersession, air-gap sealing, custody transfer (sessions) via the host's MCP client
grounding: references/grounding.md; runtime containment (hold/suspend/seal/transfer) is OUTSIDE Loomground - only removing authority / adding prohibition / lowering grade is a Loomground proposal
invariants: runtime containment is not a Loomground declaration; only an actual policy change proposes a construct
tightening (freeze, revoke, seal) is immediate; loosening back needs a named approver and rationale
revocation is a signed tombstone that cannot recall what already left the boundary
a sealed folder builds no network request and is never routed to a cloud model
custody transfer across machines is same-key only
no-id wall holds even during an incident
